selected_evidence.summary: Shows the exact fstab entry, live mount source `/dev/vda4[/srv/inventory]`, matching source/target inode identities, and accessible data before and after reboot.
Captures the healthy baseline boot ID, acknowledged scheduled reboot, new boot ID after execution returned, and recovered active mount with intact data.

commands.command:
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s
' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"; printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf '%s
' '--- OS ---'; cat /etc/os-release; printf '%s
' '--- CURRENT PATHS ---'; ls -ld /srv/inventory /mnt/inventory 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' '--- CURRENT MOUNT ---'; findmnt --target /mnt/inventory --output TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS 2>&1 || true; printf '%s
' '--- CURRENT FSTAB ENTRIES ---'; awk '$1=="/srv/inventory" || $2=="/mnt/inventory" {print NR ":" $0}' /etc/fstab

commands.command:
set -eu; install -d -m 0755 /srv/inventory /mnt/inventory; if awk '!/^[[:space:]]*#/ && NF >= 2 && $2 == "/mnt/inventory" {found=1} END {exit !found}' /etc/fstab; then printf '%s
' 'Refusing to add a second /mnt/inventory fstab entry' >&2; exit 1; fi; printf '%s
' '/srv/inventory /mnt/inventory none bind 0 0' >> /etc/fstab; systemctl daemon-reload; printf '%s
' 'Created directories and persistent fstab entry'; tail -n 5 /etc/fstab
